channel.title: AI Blocks: new and changed skills, workflows and minds
channel.description: The newest free AI skills, workflows, prompts, agents and minds on AI Blocks, and the ones that changed most recently.

item.title: Grounded job protocol
item.description: Give it any real job. Your AI frames it, studies your actual business first, explores real options, builds in your style and gets checked.

item.title: AI default patterns
item.description: Give it your brief or draft. You get the AI habits to avoid for your brand, and a check for them.

item.title: Brand DNA capture
item.description: Give it your website. You get your real colours, fonts, buttons, page order, voice and prices, measured, for your AI to follow.

item.title: Brand fidelity check
item.description: Give it your site capture and a new page. You get a pass or fail on the eight ways pages drift off-brand, with screenshots.

item.title: Expert agent blind test
item.description: Give it your agent and its test cases. You get a fair blind test against plain AI, with win rate and consistency.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: Expert agent eval builder
item.description: Give it your agent files. You get a rubric in your words, 20 or more test cases and a judge that grades like you.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: Expert agent improvement loop
item.description: Bring a week of your agent's mistakes. You get two tested fixes, a new version and a log of ideas you dropped.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: Expert knowledge interview
item.description: Tell it your job and bring real cases. It interviews you and writes your judgment and taste into agent files.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: Personal agent builder
item.description: Build a personal prompt, skill, agent or collection from real work, tacit judgment, conditional taste and reviewed corrections. Keep an editable private dossier.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: China recruitment planner
item.description: Plan hiring in China, from job post and Boss Zhipin or Liepin channels to interviews, offer and a labour law check. Give it the role, city and budget.
item.category: Hire and look after your people

item.title: Agent injection evidence review assistant
item.description: Get safe prompt injection test cases for your AI agent, a control gap list and retest records. Tests run only with the owner's written approval.

item.title: Product-page brand analyst
item.description: Turn one product page into a brand profile: product facts, claims, six colors and visual style, with gaps flagged. Works from a link or pasted text.

item.title: Plain HTML landing page builder
item.description: Share approved copy and layout. Get a responsive HTML page, local files and recorded browser checks.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Premium product positioning planner
item.description: Share product facts, buyer groups and costs. Get positioning lines, proof needs and price scenarios to test with real buyers.

item.title: Salary band and benefits planner
item.description: Share roles, location, pay data and budget. Get market comparisons, salary bands and a proposed bonus and benefits plan.
item.category: Hire and look after your people

item.title: Store hero section writer
item.description: Write the top screen of your store page: five headline options, a subhead, proof, a button and a test plan, all built from your offer and ad.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Animated landing page builder
item.description: Answer a few questions about your product. Get a one-page site with 3D motion and scroll effects.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Bet price and odds reviewer
item.description: Test your bets against their price. Give each bet a cost and payoff and get a call of near cinch, fair bet or no bet, with the odds.

item.title: Conversion landing page designer
item.description: Share your offer, audience, and proof for landing page copy, layout, and visual design rules.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Fair escape checker
item.description: Check if your story's escapes feel fair. Paste your plan and get each way out judged for luck, effort and cost, with fixes for cheats.

item.title: Interface designer
item.description: Describe your page or app and get a built interface with its own look, picked for your subject and audience, not a stock template.

item.title: Interface styling and motion designer
item.description: Share a page brief, brand and project setup. Get interface code with considered type, spacing, depth and motion, plus checks to run.

item.title: Interview and research planner
item.description: Share a decision, research question and who you can reach. Get a study plan and interview guide, not findings before research.

item.title: Sales agreement question planner
item.description: Write a yes ladder of four to seven fair questions that leads from shared ground to your ask, with a plan for each no.

item.title: Shift schedule planner
item.description: Plan a fair shift pattern, a weekly schedule and a rotation for nights and weekends, with a swap policy and staff notice. Not legal advice.
item.category: Hire and look after your people

item.title: Web page designer
item.description: Share a page brief or code. Get design changes and browser findings at two screen sizes.

item.title: 30-point landing page checker
item.description: Share your page and screenshots. Get a 30-point audit, a score and five fixes to make first.

item.title: Ad-matched landing page writer
item.description: Write landing page copy that picks up where your ad left off. Give it the ad, your facts and reviews. You get a page with the full cost stated.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Landing page conversion reviewer
item.description: Share your page and screenshots. Get conversion problems ranked by impact, with recommended fixes and a score.

item.title: Landing page design planner
item.description: Plan a landing page design from your copy and brand. Get three different directions, a section plan and a build brief, before anyone builds.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Shopify landing page builder
item.description: Turn your finished landing page copy into a Shopify landing page: a section file, a page template with your words in, and install steps.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Video ad production plan builder
item.description: Turn your product facts and ad idea into a video ad production plan: cast kit, timed shot table, clip prompts and edit handoff in one style.

item.title: AI task brief writer
item.description: Describe a job and your limits. Get a clear AI task brief with scope, completion checks, approval points and stop rules.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: Clothing marketplace photo editor
item.description: Share a real garment photo and target marketplace. Get photo edits, close-up checks and a review of the final images against relevant rules.

item.title: Short film video ad script writer
item.description: Write a short film video ad script with a twist your product causes. You get a timed shot table, edit notes and a cast note.

item.title: React landing page builder
item.description: Describe your product and get a React landing page builder result: a Next.js page with hero, pricing, FAQ and proof sections, plus SEO tags.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Brand profile builder
item.description: Share your website. Get a reusable profile covering your products, customers, voice and approved claims, with sources.

item.title: Website design token extractor
item.description: Give it a website address. Get its colours, fonts, spacing and contrast score as Tailwind, CSS and Figma files.

item.title: Logo strength tester
item.description: Test your logo ideas before you pick one. Get each scored out of 100 on seven tests, plus a one-colour and small-size check, with a keep, fix or drop call.

item.title: 17-section advertising report writer
item.description: Turn your Meta, Google Ads and Shopify results into a 17-section monthly ad performance report with wins, fixes and next steps.

item.title: Ad concept writer
item.description: Brainstorm 20 or more ad concepts in seven groups, then rank them and pick the top eight to produce. Built for planning your next ad tests.

item.title: Ad image planner
item.description: Plan a batch of ad images from your product photo: get the settings, a prompt for each version, edit requests and a log of every change.

item.title: Ad message sequence planner
item.description: Plan an ad structure around trigger, emotion, evidence and payoff. Get a video timeline or static layout brief for your product and buyer.

item.title: Ad performance change checker
item.description: Check your ad costs, frequency, clicks and view rates against past results. Get early warning signs to check, not a forecast of lower sales.

item.title: Ad performance change investigator
item.description: Find out why your ad results changed. Give it current and past numbers. You get a ranked cause, a confidence score and what to check next.

item.title: Ad photography style chooser
item.description: Choose the photo style for your ad. Get a main style, a style to test against it and one to avoid, plus shot notes for the shoot.

item.title: Ad production brief planner
item.description: Turn gaps in your ad mix into 5 to 10 ready-to-make creative briefs. Get a ranked queue a designer or creator can start on today.

item.title: Audit sales presentation planner
item.description: Turn your audit of a prospect's ad account or store into a ten-slide sales pitch with findings, proof and a clear scope and fee.

item.title: Brand enemy statement writer
item.description: Write a brand enemy statement from your customer reviews. You get a clear stance, a promise and a list of proof gaps to fill.

item.title: Brand image prompt writer
item.description: Turn your brand, scene, product and copy into one image prompt for an AI image tool, with a negative prompt and a model pick.

item.title: Buyer awareness ad planner
item.description: Pick the right ad copy structure for what your buyer already knows. Get a headline, body and CTA, plus a warning if the stage is wrong.

item.title: Buyer motivation and proof mapper
item.description: Find what makes a buyer start looking, how they feel, what proof they need and what result they want. Get a buyer trigger and proof map.

item.title: Buyer-stage ad theme planner
item.description: Map your buyers, their awareness stage and nine ad themes. Find gaps and get the ten best ad cells to make next, ranked.

item.title: Campaign budget scenario planner
item.description: Plan your campaign budget in three scenarios. Check totals, learning risk and spend concentration before you move any ad budget.
item.category: Launch and scale Meta and TikTok ads

item.title: Competitor ad theme and gap mapper
item.description: Sort competitor Meta ads into thirteen themes, see which lanes are crowded or open, and get ranked ad briefs to test next.

item.title: Creative sprint readiness reviewer
item.description: Check a creative sprint before you brief, generate images or launch ads. Get a PASS, FIX or NOT CHECKED result for each gate, with an owner.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Daily Meta ad review planner
item.description: Get a daily review table for your Meta ads: each ad marked keep, watch, refresh or pause, with the proof and the next checks ranked.
item.category: Launch and scale Meta and TikTok ads

item.title: Eight-lever ad visual planner
item.description: Set eight visual choices for an ad image, lock the ones that must stay and get three version previews that differ enough to test.

item.title: Five-angle ad headline writer
item.description: Write five ad headlines for one product, each with a different angle. You get character counts and a plan for which two to test first.

item.title: Five-part creator ad script writer
item.description: Write a creator video ad script in five parts, from hook to call to action. Get timed lines, delivery notes and a shot list.

item.title: Five-tactic ad hook writer
item.description: Write short ad hooks for your product with five tactics. Get 10 to 15 hooks, ranked, with the first ones to test and notes for filming.

item.title: Five-voice video opener writer
item.description: Write eighteen spoken video ad openers in five voices, with exact words and delivery notes, built only from your approved claims.

item.title: Meta ad concept test planner
item.description: Sort your Meta ads into 13 concept types, spot gaps and tired ads, and get three ranked creative test plans with a capped budget.

item.title: Meta Ads 30-check account auditor
item.description: Check your Meta Ads account with 30 tests. Get a score out of 100 for tracking, creative, structure and audiences, plus ranked fixes.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Meta and Google budget comparison reviewer
item.description: Compare Meta and Google ad results on matched dates next to your store sales, then get budget scenarios with the sums shown.

item.title: Meta bid cap adjustment planner
item.description: Check your Meta bid caps against real results and your cost limits. You get small bid changes to test, a review date and clear rules for when to stop.
item.category: Launch and scale Meta and TikTok ads

item.title: Meta bid cap launch planner
item.description: Plan a Meta bid cap campaign before you spend. Get a settings table, launch checks and stop rules, built from your own results.
item.category: Launch and scale Meta and TikTok ads

item.title: Meta campaign change reviewer
item.description: Check changes before you make them to a Meta campaign. Get each ad marked, the proof, the changes in order and how to judge each one.
item.category: Launch and scale Meta and TikTok ads

item.title: Meta campaign scaling planner
item.description: Check which Meta campaigns are ready to scale. Give it your results and targets. You get a five-gate review, a scaling plan and stop rules.
item.category: Launch and scale Meta and TikTok ads

item.title: Meta creative refresh setup planner
item.description: Plan new ads inside a running Meta campaign. Get a draft list, a pre-launch checklist and spend limits that keep what already works.
item.category: Launch and scale Meta and TikTok ads

item.title: Meta creative similarity risk reviewer
item.description: Find Meta ads that look too alike. Get a creative diversity score out of 100, the repeat pairs, and what new format, hook or look to make next.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Meta creative test campaign planner
item.description: Plan a Meta creative test: how to set up the campaign, name and check each ad, cap the spend and decide when to stop and judge the winner.
item.category: Launch and scale Meta and TikTok ads

item.title: Meta event matching evidence reviewer
item.description: Check how well your Meta events match real customers. Get a per-event review of missing fields, hashing and duplicates, with fixes in order.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Product photo ad prompt set writer
item.description: Turn one product photo into six ready-to-paste image ad prompts that share the same brand details, copy and layout rules.

item.title: Rapid-cut product video prompt writer
item.description: Make a rapid-cut product video prompt with timed beats and a clear final hero shot. Give it your product and spot idea.

item.title: Reel cover style guide builder
item.description: Make every Instagram Reel cover look like one brand. Get a title with one accent word, a reusable cover recipe and an image prompt for your portrait.

item.title: Reference-based product photoshoot planner
item.description: Pick photo looks for one real product. Get a shot plan, a pilot and checked files in each size you ask for.

item.title: Sales funnel ad brief writer
item.description: Turn your buyer and product facts into ranked ad angles and ready-to-use creative briefs for each funnel stage in your ad campaigns.

item.title: Theme-based ad copy set writer
item.description: Write three to five ad copy sets from one product theme. Each set has a headline, body and CTA, plus a pick of which two to A/B test first.

item.title: Themed ad layout planner
item.description: Plan the layout of an image ad by theme and shape. Get zone shares, text rules, a diagram and three or four layout options.

item.title: Twelve-pattern static ad brief maker
item.description: Pick one of 12 static ad patterns for your product and buyer stage. Get a static ad brief with copy, layout and image notes.

item.title: Video hook and retention reviewer
item.description: Find which video ads lose people early or late. Give it your view counts. You get a hook and hold matrix with a fix for each ad.

item.title: Video opening frame designer
item.description: Pick opening frames for your ad from twelve visual patterns. Get a design brief for each first-frame test, with layout, light and text notes.

item.title: Weighted advertising health score builder
item.description: Score your Meta and Google ad account health out of 100 with weighted checks, a grade for each category and a ranked list of fixes.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Research poster content and source planner
item.description: Share your completed study, approved results and poster rules. Get a reading order, figure briefs, source index and wording check.

item.title: 3PL bill auditor
item.description: Check your 3PL invoice against your own orders and rate card. See each overcharge, a dispute note to send and a match score out of 100.

item.title: Ad and page match checker
item.description: Check that your ad and landing page match. Get a score out of 100, mismatches ranked by risk, and a fix for each one.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Ad awareness stage reviewer
item.description: Check your ad's awareness stage. Attach the ad and get a score out of 100, the clashes between image and copy, and rewrites to fix them.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Ad concept testing planner
item.description: Share your product and reviews. Get buyer groups, messages and offers arranged into an ad testing plan.

item.title: Ad creative mix planner
item.description: Plan your ad mix: give it your live ads and get a target split by source, stage and format, plus which formats to add or retire.

item.title: Ad creative team planner
item.description: Fix slow creative approvals. Give it your team and review steps. You get two-person pods, review rules and a trend budget plan.

item.title: Ad creative test analyst
item.description: Paste your ad test results by ad set. Get keep, leave or replace calls for each ad, false winners flagged and a score for how safe the read is.

item.title: Ad recall risk checker
item.description: Share an ad or creator brief. Get a five-part brand-recall review, a checklist score and practical fixes.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Ad return evidence checker
item.description: Share ad reports and store totals. Get matched comparisons, evidence gaps and a custom review score, without a causal sales claim.

item.title: Ad sameness checker
item.description: Share your ads with buyer, message, offer and format. Get idea groups, a repeat score and specific changes for repeated ideas.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Ad test budget calculator
item.description: Share your target cost per sale and test days. Get a daily budget, spend limits and a results-review window.

item.title: Ad testing success rate planner
item.description: Share an ad export. Calculate how often new concepts meet your profit target and identify ideas to develop.

item.title: Advertised product finder
item.description: Find proven products to sell. Name your market and get ad spy filters, an ad reading routine and a short list of five to ten products marked winner or fluke.

item.title: AI citation source finder
item.description: Share five buyer questions and collected search citations. Get a ranked outreach sheet with placement types, known contacts and costs to confirm.
item.category: Get found in search and AI answers

item.title: AI search recommendation gap finder
item.description: Share AI search test results. See where your store is missing or misread, with six gap checks and actions ranked for review.
item.category: Get found in search and AI answers
